r7-rationale.title: _g vs _ms2 rationale correctness
r7-rationale.imperative: Producer/store = density/mass-agnostic grip coefficient (poolable); consumer = per-session m/s²; one seam at car_prior. Rationale correct and honest.
r7-rationale.finding: _g vs _ms2 rationale (doc lines 58-78) is correct: LateralView produces dimensionless g-unit coefficient mu_max(v) = A0 + A2*v^2 (density/mass-agnostic, poolable). Consumer LateralParameters.lateral_capability uses m/s^2. Conversion seam is car_prior._assemble_lateral (confirmed in car_prior.py L424-475: A0_param=A0_g*G, A2_param=A2_g*G/air_density — Jacobian diag(G, G/rho) verified in code). Factor-of-10 error on raw g-units (doc cites ~17 m/s vs ~63 m/s for Monaco tunnel) matches the code comment at L443-444. Doc correctly states the single seam and that _ms2 suffix marks consumer space.
